name: Yuri Nobuya
source:
Daisuke's father and the current Minister of Health, Labor and Welfare of Japan. He is Kuze's uncle. After working as a director of a pharmaceutical company and a newspaper reporter, he became a politician, and served as the chairman of the House of Representatives' Committee on Audit and Oversight of Administration and the Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. Although he is notoriously forceful, he is well known in the political world and his skills have earned him many followers.

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
